response.rationale: The high troponin and LAD filling defect strongly support acute coronary syndrome. Normal ECG and echo favor NSTEMI over STEMI. OCT no lipid points to plaque erosion rather than rupture, making D1 most likely. Embolism is less likely given normal hypercoagulability work-up. SCAD is possible but less common in men. Vasospasm is less likely due to the large filling defect. Hypercoagulable state is contradicted by normal work-up.
